ai.title: Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents
ai.brief: Vercel has released durable-harness , an open-source package that keeps coding agent sessions alive through crashes and timeouts. Vercel durable-harness wraps existing harnesses, including Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex, without changing them . Each session lives in a durable log. A dead function no longer means lost work. For teams moving agents off laptops and into the cloud, that closes a real gap. 0. Adapters cover 5 harnesses: Pi, OpenCode, fx, Claude Code, Codex. js 22+ with Postgres, or laptop files. Claude Code and Codex need a Vercel Sandbox. Performance: No latency or throughput benchmarks published. All recovery claims are self-reported by Vercel. Best: Finished model and tool calls are read back from the log, never re-run or billed twice. x API. Claude Code and Codex run only in a Vercel Sandbox, even self-hosted. What is durable-harness?
